text: REST API can read, create, and update pages, databases, users, and comments across a workspace
quote: With the REST API, you can read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace — pages, databases, users, comments, and more.

text: Personal access tokens let scripts, CLIs, or Workers act as a single Notion user
quote: Personal access tokens (PATs) are user-scoped tokens for scripts, CLI workflows, Workers, and tools that should act as one Notion user.

text: Connections can subscribe to real-time webhooks for page updates, property changes, and new comments
quote: Connections can subscribe to real-time events — like page updates, property changes, and new comments — via webhooks.

text: Public connections authenticate via OAuth 2.0 and must pass a Notion security review before Marketplace listing
quote: Public connections use OAuth 2.0 for authentication... Public connections must undergo a Notion security review before being listed on the Marketplace.

text: Internal connections are scoped to a single workspace using a static API token
quote: Internal connections are scoped to a single workspace and use a static API token.

text: AI can answer questions instantly with citations pulled from workspace content
Agents can keep work moving autonomously around the clock
Users can build custom AI agents that perform work autonomously, not just assist with it
quote: Notion Custom Agents help our team go beyond doing work with AI to building AI tools that do the work for them.
